from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyNetIncome(BaseModel):
    """A single company's consolidated net income for the quarter in question."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the filing")
    net_income: float | None = Field(description="The reported net income amount; losses are negative")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the filing")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_net_incomes: list[CompanyNetIncome]
